comparison

Source: vignettes/comparison.Rmd
comparison.Rmd
library(icsp2)
library(haven)
idu <- read_dta("./local/idu.dta")
idu_1 <- ic_sp_ph(
  Surv(ltime, rtime, type = "interval2") ~ age_mean +
    male +
    needle +
    inject +
    jail,
  data = idu
)
idu_1_res <- summary(idu_1)
within(as.data.frame(idu_1_res$coef_matrix), {
  HR = exp(Estimate)
  HR_u = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * Std.Error)
  HR_l = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * Std.Error)
})
